ITEM_LUBRICANT_RESIN_DESCRIPTION: Refined slick polymer used in moving seals, actuators, and heavy tools.

ITEM_PRESSURE_SEAL_DESCRIPTION: Layered seal rated for flooded modules, hatch rings, and suit pressure joints.

ITEM_REINFORCED_PLATE_DESCRIPTION: Structural plate for sockets, base frames, and high-load field hardware.
ITEM_RELAY_MATRIX_DESCRIPTION: Advanced relay heart for power routing, outpost links, and control grids.

ITEM_SENSOR_PACKAGE_DESCRIPTION: Integrated detection pack for survey tools and telemetry hardware.

ITEM_STRUCTURAL_BRACKET_DESCRIPTION: Load-bearing brace for sockets, pylons, pump mounts, and frame junctions.
ITEM_ELECTROLYTE_AMPOULE_DESCRIPTION: Quick recharge ampoule for stabilizing suit power and portable field systems.
ITEM_EMERGENCY_O2_CANISTER_DESCRIPTION: Compressed emergency oxygen reserve for long pushes and bad route calls.
ITEM_FIELD_MED_GEL_DESCRIPTION: Pressure-safe medical gel for patching suit trauma and restoring integrity.
ITEM_ABYSSAL_CRYSTAL_DESCRIPTION: Rare deep-zone crystal used in the toughest pressure systems and endgame modules.
ITEM_BIOLUM_PASTE_DESCRIPTION: Compressed glowing biomass for route marks, dark optics, and relay IDs.
ITEM_COBALT_ALLOY_DESCRIPTION: Durable alloy body stock for late housings, coils, and weapon frames.
ITEM_COPPER_DESCRIPTION: Common conductive ore used in wiring, signal parts, and entry-grade tools.
ITEM_ELECTROLYTE_SALTS_DESCRIPTION: Reactive salt clusters used in cells, coolant chemistry, and power balance.
ITEM_ENZYME_CORAL_DESCRIPTION: Catalytic coral growth used in bonding compounds and advanced bio mixes.
ITEM_FIBER_KELP_DESCRIPTION: Flexible organic ribbon used for mesh, binding, and early suit work.
ITEM_GOLD_ORE_DESCRIPTION: High-grade conductive ore for stable boards, precision contacts, and optics.
ITEM_HYDROCARBON_RESIN_DESCRIPTION: Sticky deep-sea resin for polymers, lubricants, and pressure-safe seal mixes.
ITEM_IRON_COMPOSITE_DESCRIPTION: Dense structural alloy for braces, frames, and heavy platform work.
ITEM_LITHIUM_CRYSTAL_DESCRIPTION: High-density crystal used in reinforced cells and late structural parts.
ITEM_MEMBRANE_TISSUE_DESCRIPTION: Pressure-flexible organic tissue used in filters, seals, and bladder systems.
ITEM_NICKEL_ORE_DESCRIPTION: Pressure-tolerant metal stock for deep structures and heavy field systems.
ITEM_RARE_EARTH_DUST_DESCRIPTION: Fine precision mineral used in guidance, stabilization, and advanced relays.
ITEM_SILICA_SHARDS_DESCRIPTION: Fragmented mineral glass used for panels, optics, and sealed viewports.
ITEM_SILVER_ORE_DESCRIPTION: Higher-grade conductive ore for stable contacts, boards, and fine signal paths.
ITEM_SULFUR_CLUMPS_DESCRIPTION: Reactive chemical lumps used in energetic packs, cutters, and seal compounds.
ITEM_THERMAL_GEL_DESCRIPTION: Heat-stable gel used to buffer cutting systems, lamps, and hot circuits.
ITEM_TITANIUM_SCRAP_DESCRIPTION: Recovered structural scrap used for hull work, brackets, and basic fabrication.
ITEM_TUNGSTEN_CHUNK_DESCRIPTION: Heavy tool metal for cutters, launchers, and impact-rated mechanisms.
ITEM_BUILDER_DEVICE_DESCRIPTION: Handheld fabrication device used to place, rotate, and dismantle field structures.
LOG_ATLAS6_TERMINAL_SECTOR3_SUBTITLE: Access denied. Sector 3 archive remains sealed behind Atlas-6 authority checks. Manual route still dead.
LOG_ATLAS6_TERMINAL_SECTOR3_SUMMARY: Terminal capture of a failed Atlas-6 access attempt. Confirms Chen_M was still trying to breach Sector 3 through surviving maintenance routes.
LOG_BIOLOGIST_SAMPLES_SUBTITLE: Silica flora keeps growing through the pressure seams. If it survives this depth, it is feeding on something we still have not measured.
LOG_BIOLOGIST_SAMPLES_SUMMARY: Field note from the biology station. Tracks abnormal silica flora growth and hints at a deeper energy source inside the trench ecosystem.
LOG_CAPTAIN_LAST_BROADCAST_SUBTITLE: Atlas... no response. All hands break silence protocol and head for sealed shelter. This is no drill.
LOG_CAPTAIN_LAST_BROADCAST_SUMMARY: Last live command broadcast recovered from the command chain. Marks the moment the station accepted full systems collapse.
LOG_CHEN_M_DATAPAD_01_SUBTITLE: If the lock jams a second time, I am keeping notes by hand. I do not trust automation in this compartment anymore.
LOG_CHEN_M_DATAPAD_01_SUMMARY: Technical and personal note from engineer Chen_M. Documents repeated airlock failures and early signs of sabotage in the habitation loop.
LOG_MEDIC_DIARY_SUBTITLE: Depth syndrome is no longer isolated to long-shift crews. Hallucinations are appearing before the pressure alarms trip.
LOG_MEDIC_DIARY_SUMMARY: Medical diary entry recording accelerated pressure syndrome across the crew. Suggests the anomaly was spreading faster than command admitted.
QUEST_QUEST_ARRIVAL_DESCRIPTION: Run the startup protocol after arriving on Hecton-8.
QUEST_QUEST_BIOME_SPINE_DESCRIPTION: Confirm entry into the first open-water biome spine.
QUEST_QUEST_ATLAS_CORE_REACHED_DESCRIPTI: Reach the Atlas-6 core at terminal depth.
QUEST_QUEST_FIRST_BREATH_DESCRIPTION: Reach 150 m and push beyond the first pressure layer.
QUEST_QUEST_ATLAS_SIGNAL_DECODED_DESCRIP: Wait for full signal decryption and push deeper.
QUEST_QUEST_ATLAS_SIGNAL_DETECTED_DESCRI: Lock the first Atlas-6 signal and send it for decryption.
DEPTH_ZONE_ZONE_THE_SPINE_DESCRIPTION: Start zone. Shallow water. Safe. Coral reefs and bright turquoise water.
DEPTH_ZONE_ZONE_DROWNED_FACTORIES_DESCRI: Western slope. Flooded colony modules. Primary investigation zone.
DEPTH_ZONE_ZONE_THE_DROP_UPPER_DESCRIPTI: Eastern wall. Sudden vertical drop. Absolute darkness. Leviathans.
DEPTH_ZONE_ZONE_DEEP_ABYSS_DESCRIPTION: Abyssal plain. Monotonous terrain. Isolation. Equipment failure is lethal.
DEPTH_ZONE_ZONE_THERMAL_FIELDS_DESCRIPTI: Rift zones. Hydrothermal vents. The deepest and liveliest place. Atlas-6 core.
SUIT_UPGRADE_SUIT_HULL_T1_PRESSURE_SHELL: The first hull upgrade. Holds to -500 m and opens the early deep route.
SUIT_UPGRADE_SUIT_HULL_T2_PRESSURE_LATTI: Reinforces the frame for mid-depth pressure. It fails on mass now, not noise.
SUIT_UPGRADE_SUIT_HULL_T3_ABYSSAL_FRAME_: Frame for abyssal range. It only matters once the player knows why they are going deeper.
SUIT_UPGRADE_SUIT_HULL_T4_THERMAL_SHELL_: Final hull circuit. Survives the thermal rift and depths down to -5000 m.
SUIT_UPGRADE_SUIT_OXYGEN_T1_AUX_RESERVOI: Additional O2 reserve for the first crafted upgrade step. Increases air supply without rebuilding the hull.
CORP_DEEP_REACH_OFFICIAL_MISSION: Colonization of remote worlds. Scientific research. Terraforming.
CORP_DEEP_REACH_REAL_MISSION: Extraction of Xenon-Ω isotope. Testing Atlas-6 AI under full autonomy. Military foothold in the Aegir system.
CORP_DEEP_REACH_PLAYER_BRIEFING: You are a scavenger engineer. Minimal support. Solo mission. The corporation is willing to lose 100 scavengers for 1 kg of Xenon-Ω. You do not know the full price of what you are collecting.
CORP_FACTION_ETHICS_PHILOSOPHY: They consider the mission criminal. They knew the risk of catastrophe. They want the truth exposed.
CORP_FACTION_PRAGMATISTS_PHILOSOPHY: They demand results at any cost. Losses are acceptable for data. Xenon-Ω matters more than lives.
CORP_ORDER_ORDER_EXTRACT_XENON_TEXT: ALPHA PRIORITY: Extract the maximum amount of Xenon-Ω. Atlas-6 is a secondary objective. Return with the cargo.
CORP_ORDER_ORDER_PRESERVE_ECOSYSTEM_TEXT: ATTENTION: Evidence confirms life existed here before human arrival. DO NOT DESTROY. Document everything. Return with the data.
CORP_ORDER_ORDER_SHUTDOWN_ATLAS_TEXT: Atlas-6 is out of control. Destroy the core. Seed Program data is priority.
CORP_ORDER_ORDER_PRESERVE_SIGNAL_TEXT: Atlas-6 is building a protection signal. If that is true, do not touch it. Let the signal stand.
CORP_ISOTOPE_XENON_OMEGA_PROPERTIES: Stable only at pressures above 100 ATM.
CORP_ISOTOPE_XENON_OMEGA_EXCLUSIVITY: A unique mix of pressure, temperature, and geochemistry on Hecton-8.
CORP_ISOTOPE_SILICON_7B_PROPERTIES: A semiconductor with zero resistance at -100°C.
CORP_ISOTOPE_SILICON_7B_EXCLUSIVITY: Forms only in silicon ecosystems under pressure.
CORP_ISOTOPE_AEGIRIUM_EXCLUSIVITY: A decay product in Aegir's atmosphere that precipitates onto the moon.
COLONIST_CHEN_M_DATAPAD_01_DESCRIPTION: Technical report. Dry. Date: 847 days ago.
COLONIST_CHEN_M_DATAPAD_02_DESCRIPTION: "We hear movement under the module. Reporting it."
COLONIST_CHEN_M_BLUEPRINT_DESCRIPTION: A modification schematic for a standard Atlas-6 drone. Someone tried to reprogram it.
COLONIST_CHEN_M_SUIT_DESCRIPTION: A diving suit on the seabed. Beside it lies a handmade tool of unknown purpose.
COLONIST_CAPTAIN_LAST_BROADCAST_DESCRIPT: "Atlas... it isn't responding. But we can see it... growing." The message ends in scraping metal.
COLONIST_BIOLOGIST_SAMPLES_DESCRIPTION: Samples of silicon flora with notes about "strange behavior." First signs of Atlas adapting to biomass.
COLONIST_MEDIC_DIARY_DESCRIPTION: Description of the "depth syndrome": hallucinations, paranoia, empty ampoules.
COLONIST_CHILD_DRAWING_DESCRIPTION: A child's drawing. A toy lies nearby. Innocence set against catastrophe.
COLONIST_ATLAS6_TERMINAL_SECTOR3_DESCRIP: An attempted breach of the Atlas-6 system by user CHEN_M. Failed. Date: 847 days ago.
COLONIST_FIRST_HOUR_SHADOW_EVENT_DESCRIP: First-hour fear beat. A large fast shadow cuts in from the left to break overconfidence.
COLONIST_FIRST_COLONY_MODULE_SPOTTED_DES: The first orientation target of the opening hour. It should read as a distant objective, not a hard marker.
COLONIST_ZONE_THE_SPINE_DESCRIPTION: Start zone. Shallow water. Safe orientation. Coral reefs and the first visibility lesson.
COLONIST_ZONE_DROWNED_FACTORIES_DESCRIPT: Western slope. Flooded colony modules. The first real pressure ramp and rise in risk.
COLONIST_ZONE_THE_DROP_UPPER_DESCRIPTION: Eastern wall. Sudden vertical drop. Absolute darkness. Leviathans and the shift into full tension.
COLONIST_ZONE_DEEP_ABYSS_DESCRIPTION: Abyssal plain. Isolation. Equipment failure is lethal. Narrative should turn into dread here.
COLONIST_ZONE_THERMAL_FIELDS_DESCRIPTION: Rift zones. Hydrothermal vents. The deepest living space. Atlas-6 core and the third-act endpoint.
FAUNA_CREATURE_REEF_GLIDER_DESCRIPTION: A gigantic ray with corals and glowing algae on its back. Its movement is slow and majestic. It ignores the player. You can ride on its back.
FAUNA_CREATURE_REEF_GLIDER_ROLE: Shows scale. Beautiful screenshot subject. Gives a sense of a living world.
FAUNA_CREATURE_REEF_GLIDER_SCIENCE: Giant rays are real. Coral symbiosis is a real phenomenon.
FAUNA_CREATURE_GLASSWORM_DESCRIPTION: A giant translucent filter-worm. It bends slowly through the water column. If you swim inside it, it spits you out without lethal damage.
FAUNA_CREATURE_GLASSWORM_ROLE: Visual variety. Creates a sense of wonder.
FAUNA_CREATURE_GLASSWORM_SCIENCE: Filter-feeders are real: salps, pyrosomes. This is a giant extrapolation.
FAUNA_CREATURE_TITAN_LEVIATHAN_DESCRIPTI: A massive eel with metallized scales and a hydraulic jaw. Glowing discharges run along its spine. It patrols slowly and emits a low-frequency hum.
FAUNA_CREATURE_TITAN_LEVIATHAN_ROLE: Primary apex predator. Visible from afar. Builds anticipation.
FAUNA_CREATURE_TITAN_LEVIATHAN_SCIENCE: Giant eels are real. Electric organs are real.
FAUNA_CREATURE_TITAN_LEVIATHAN_NIGHT: Moves higher in the water column, up to 500 m. Hunts actively.
FAUNA_CREATURE_VOLT_MANTA_HABITAT: Western shelf, near the ruins (100–800 m)
FAUNA_CREATURE_VOLT_MANTA_DESCRIPTION: A huge ray with a long tail-generator. It guards valuable wreckage. It does not kill outright, but it can stun with a discharge.
FAUNA_CREATURE_VOLT_MANTA_ROLE: Guards resources. Forces the player to think instead of just shooting.
FAUNA_CREATURE_VOLT_MANTA_NIGHT: Patrols actively at night. More aggressive.
FAUNA_CREATURE_ABYSSAL_NIGHTMARE_DESCRIP: Translucent and nearly invisible in darkness. Only the eyes and inner organs glow. It hangs motionless until it snaps shut toward the player.
FAUNA_CREATURE_ABYSSAL_NIGHTMARE_ROLE: A screamer creature. Works through contrast with silence.
FAUNA_CREATURE_ABYSSAL_NIGHTMARE_SCIENCE: Deep-sea fish really can be translucent.
FAUNA_CREATURE_THERMAL_PHANTOM_DESCRIPTI: A translucent jelly-like creature that lives along the thermocline. Its tentacles burn and shove the player upward. Painful, but not lethal.
FAUNA_CREATURE_THERMAL_PHANTOM_ROLE: A marker that says: farther ahead is dangerous, upgrade required.
FAUNA_CREATURE_THERMAL_PHANTOM_SCIENCE: The thermocline is real. Jellyfish with thermal lenses are speculative.
FAUNA_CREATURE_ROOT_DRAGON_DESCRIPTION: A giant organism half-grown into the rock. Only the snout and a pair of limbs protrude. It seems asleep. If you approach, the head turns slowly. It does not attack, but the stare freezes you.
FAUNA_CREATURE_ROOT_DRAGON_ROLE: Psychological barrier. The player never knows whether it will wake.
FAUNA_CREATURE_ROOT_DRAGON_SCIENCE: Organisms fused into substrate are real: sea lilies, ascidians.
FAUNA_CREATURE_TERMITE_WORM_DESCRIPTION: A colossal worm that drills tunnels through rock. Its body is armored with metal and stone. The head is a giant cutter. Neutral at first, but capable of destroying player structures.
FAUNA_CREATURE_TERMITE_WORM_ROLE: Dynamic world change. Opens new passages or destroys a base.
FAUNA_CREATURE_TERMITE_WORM_SCIENCE: Burrowing worms are real, including Eunice aphroditois.
FAUNA_CREATURE_ATLAS_DREADNOUGHT_DESCRIP: A biomechanical hybrid of crab and industrial excavator. Atlas AI towers on its back fire plasma. It guards the core. Final boss.
FAUNA_CREATURE_ATLAS_DREADNOUGHT_ROLE: Final boss. Demands tactics and the full arsenal.
FAUNA_CREATURE_ATLAS_DREADNOUGHT_SCIENCE: Biomechanical hybrids are an Atlas-6 concept, not natural fauna.
FAUNA_CREATURE_ATLAS_BUILDER_DESCRIPTION: A metal chassis threaded with organic tubing. It drags materials toward construction points. It does not attack unless disturbed. Under threat it emits a high-frequency screech and summons a Defender.
FAUNA_CREATURE_ATLAS_BUILDER_ROLE: The first drone encounter. Uncertainty is scarier than open hostility.
FAUNA_CREATURE_ATLAS_BUILDER_SCIENCE: A product of the Atlas-6 Seed Program.
FAUNA_CREATURE_ATLAS_DEFENDER_DESCRIPTIO: A combat drone that reacts to the Builder's alarm. Aggressive. Guards construction zones and the Atlas-6 core.
FAUNA_CREATURE_ATLAS_DEFENDER_ROLE: Threat response when the player disrupts builder activity.
FAUNA_CREATURE_ATLAS_DEFENDER_SCIENCE: A product of the Atlas-6 Seed Program.
FAUNA_CREATURE_ATLAS_COURIER_DESCRIPTION: A small fast drone. It delivers barter capsules to beacons. No direct interaction. It is simply logistics in motion.
FAUNA_CREATURE_ATLAS_COURIER_ROLE: Atmosphere pass: Atlas-6 is not a character, but a system.
FAUNA_CREATURE_ATLAS_COURIER_SCIENCE: A product of the Atlas-6 Seed Program.
ITEM_FILTERED_WATER_DESC: Purified water from the base filtration system. Restores hydration.
ITEM_CURED_FISH_DESC: Preserved fish protein. A staple survival food.
ITEM_NUTRIENT_BLOCK_DESC: Compressed emergency ration. Dense calories, minimal taste.
ITEM_SMALL_MEDKIT_DESC: Emergency medical supplies. Repairs suit integrity.
ITEM_OXYGEN_PIPE_DESC: Emergency oxygen supply. Quick breath when you need it most.
